name: i2_bench_swap
purpose: Illusion (step I2): Zoroark leads disguised as Gholdengo. Turn 1 it switches out unbroken for Primarina (the shown name Gholdengo stays on the bench, its override kept). Turn 2 Zoroark comes back in: after the bench swap the last standing member to its right is Gholdengo again, so the entry is a disguise as the same name (allowed). A Moonblast then breaks it.
